headline: Haaland reaches 300 in a day light on hard transfer news
paragraphs: Manchester City's clearest story of the day happened on the pitch. Sky reports Erling Haaland scored the winner in a 1-0 win over Coventry, his 300th career goal, extending City's unbeaten record under Enzo Maresca. Sky ran a match report, a highlights clip and a separate analysis of debutant Fernandez's performance. It is the best-supported story involving any of the six tracked clubs today, though all three items share one outlet rather than being independently confirmed.

Arsenal and Chelsea traded early goals in Sunday's Premier League derby: per Sky, Morgan Rogers put Chelsea ahead inside two minutes before Kai Havertz leveled for Arsenal in the 25th. The Guardian ran a parallel live blog of the same match; neither report in the feed states a final score. Separately, the Guardian's European round-up said Bayern Munich were held to a 0-0 draw by Schalke.

Off the pitch, Sky reported that Liverpool's sporting director Hughes has stepped down, with no further detail and no corroborating outlet. BBC's gossip column said Liverpool could revive interest in Crystal Palace winger Ismaila Sarr in January, corroborated only by its own BBC Sport byline rather than an independent outlet. Transfermarkt's live blog linked Liverpool to Mane on Saturday and, by Sunday, to reviving the Sarr interest instead. There was no hard news today for PSG or Real Madrid, both mentioned only in an Opta feature previewing the Champions League.
